# Observability & Telemetry Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Deep production-readiness review of requirements quality, completeness, and clarity for OpenTelemetry centralized logging, distributed tracing, OpenSearch indexing, and system documentation.  
**Created**: 2026-09-15  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)  
**Audience**: Author Self-Review  
**Depth**: Deep Production-Readiness Gate  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer/author-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Dual Logging Output & OTLP Transport Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are dual logging output requirements explicitly specified so that standard console logging remains active alongside asynchronous OTLP export across all 8 services? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK002 Are the mandatory structured attributes (timestamp, severity, service name, logger, thread, message, traceId, spanId) unambiguously defined for all emitted log events? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, DataModel §1]
- [x] CHK003 Is the OTLP log transmission protocol and default endpoint (`http://otel-collector:4318/v1/logs`) specified for containerized and local environments? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification define whether non-Spring or third-party library log noise should be suppressed by default log level configurations? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is the behavior of multi-line exception stack traces explicitly required to remain encapsulated within a single structured log payload rather than split across detached lines? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]

---

## 2. Distributed Tracing & W3C Context Propagation Requirements

- [x] CHK006 Is the W3C Trace Context standard (`traceparent`, `tracestate`) explicitly mandated across all synchronous HTTP communications and asynchronous Kafka messaging channels? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK007 Are tracing propagation requirements documented for both Kafka producers and Kafka consumers to prevent broken trace trees across background event dispatching? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK008 Is default trace sampling probability quantified at 100% with requirements for externalized environment configuration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK009 Does the specification establish a clear bidirectional correlation requirement between active trace spans and log records emitted within the same execution context? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, User Story 2]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for span naming conventions across REST endpoints and messaging topics? [Consistency, DataModel §2, Contract §2]

---

## 3. OpenSearch Indexing & Ingestion Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are signal-dedicated OpenSearch index names (`otel-logs` and `otel-traces`) explicitly specified to avoid document mapping and schema collisions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK012 Is the collector exporter pipeline configuration documented for routing incoming OTLP logs and traces to OpenSearch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Summary, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK013 Are searchable field mappings in OpenSearch (timestamp, serviceName, severity, traceId) specified with appropriate indexing types? [Completeness, DataModel §3]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for handling index creation on a fresh OpenSearch deployment when zero prior indices exist? [Edge Case, Quickstart §Scenario 2, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Does the specification define expected query latency or ingestion lag bounds for log searchability in OpenSearch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

---

## 4. Resiliency, Failure Handling & Security Requirements

- [x] CHK016 Is the non-blocking and memory-bounded behavior of the OTLP exporter specified when the telemetry collector is unreachable or restarting? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases, Research §5]
- [x] CHK017 Are automatic sanitization requirements specified to redact or omit `Authorization` headers, JWT tokens, and credentials from logs and trace span attributes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications §Session 2026-09-15]
- [x] CHK018 Does the specification define recovery expectations when connectivity to the telemetry collector is restored after an outage? [Recovery Flow, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK019 Are memory exhaustion protection requirements specified for high-concurrency log volume spikes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §5]
- [x] CHK020 Does the specification require that telemetry export failures never trigger HTTP 500 errors or rollback business transactions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, SC-006]

---

## 5. Documentation & Verification Clarity Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Does the specification define mandatory architectural documentation sections for `README.md` explaining the OpenTelemetry pipeline from services to OpenSearch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK022 Are step-by-step verification commands and query examples required to be included in `README.md` for developers to test log and trace ingestion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Quickstart §Scenario 2–3]
- [x] CHK023 Does the specification define how developers configure local versus containerized telemetry endpoints in `application.yml` profiles? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK024 Are port mappings and dashboard URLs for OpenSearch (`9200`) and OpenSearch Dashboards (`5601`) documented in the platform reference matrix? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Project Structure]

---

## 6. Measurability of Success Criteria & Non-Functional Bounds

- [x] CHK025 Is the target of 100% service fleet coverage (Gateway and all 7 microservices) objectively verifiable without ambiguity? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK026 Can the ingestion latency threshold (log events queryable in OpenSearch within 5 seconds) be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK027 Is the 100% trace-log correlation criterion verifiable across multi-hop transactions spanning synchronous and asynchronous boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, SC-004]
- [x] CHK028 Can the zero-fragmentation requirement for multi-line exception stack traces be verified through negative testing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK029 Is the documentation onboarding target (new engineer correlates a transaction in OpenSearch within 10 minutes) defined with measurable completion criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after author/reviewer self-review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) until evaluation is performed.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 through CHK029) for clean cross-referencing in pull request reviews and implementation tasks.
